text: Contents: a. Chinese language: 40—60 hours b. 8 lectures c. Minority cultures trips: In and around Kunming, Dali, Lijiang, Nujiang, Xishuangbannana or other places. d. Other activities: homestay with Chinese families (including minority families), experiencing the Spring Festival with families in a village, etc. which can be arranged according to the requirements so that the participants can experience authentic Chinese people's life in cities, towns and countryside.
